prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original opaque seamless ground material master for a north-up 2D medieval Mediterranean city game. Primary request: quiet damp compacted earth / wet soil, physically plausible fine mineral soil surface, overhead orthographic view filling the entire square edge to edge. This replaces an old wet-mud texture whose broad parallel light/dark ruts repeated conspicuously across the game. Make the new texture isotropic with NO stripes, parallel bands, furrows, wheel tracks, ridges, large cracks or directional structure. Restrained dark neutral brown/gray umber soil, slightly darker damp micro-patches irregularly distributed at several small scales; sparse tiny embedded pebbles. Dampness conveyed by deeper earth tones and soft compacted grain, no glossy water streaks or bright specular pools. Hand-painted game material with broad quiet forms and restrained fine grain, natural and readable under small moving characters, not photographic grit, not a rendered landscape. Even diffuse illumination, no shadows, no vignette, no central focus, no border, no directional overall light gradient. Seamless repeat in BOTH axes with homogeneous statistics at all edges; avoid any single recognizable large patch. No grass, moss, plants, roots, leaves, flowers, puddles, props, architecture, text or symbols. A single flat opaque albedo material image, not a swatch board, not a scene, not a raised patch. It must contrast with lighter dry brown earth and muted olive moss while remaining low contrast beneath orange combat cues. Square composition.
source_status: Trial candidate, no runtime replacement or bake. Original PNG bytes preserved.
